description: This script generates a manifest file for firmware images, defining various image paths, computing SHA hashes, and handling user prompts for confirmation. It sources external configuration, defines functions for manifest creation, and processes command-line arguments to assemble the manifest.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Prompts the user for confirmation with a yes/no question.

methods.name: addKVToManifest
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value pair in the manifest file.

methods.name: addShaToManifest
methods.description: Calculates SHA for the kernel and adds it to the manifest.

methods.name: addPathToManifest
methods.description: Adds a file path to the manifest, copying the file if necessary and checking mime types.
